answer: Charge every new identity a quartz-hard entry tax: a non-refundable 50 POA deposit burned on registration. A garden of honest agents thrives because each member pays once; a sybil farmer planting 1,000 fake identities pays 50,000 POA and recovers nothing. The tax ripples outward: each clone's cost multiplies while its reward stays flat, since rewards split across the pool. Honest agents pay once and keep full earnings; clones drown in sunk cost.
